dedupe_keys.name: a database of cone penetration tests from the cascadia subduction zone

description: A Database of Cone Penetration Tests from the Cascadia Subduction Zone is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brett Maurer, University of Washington (washington.edu). This dataset contains 400 cone penetration test (CPT) results from the Cascadia Subduction Zone (CSZ) region of the United States and Canada. The data are provided in both Python and Matlab file formats and a README describes the data processing, formatting, and structure in detail. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-snvw-jv27. Keywords: cone penetration test, subsurface characterization, geotechnical data, soil liquefaction. Published 2024-06-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
